headline: Proof, Policy and the Phishing Surge
thesis: As campuses write AI rules and buyers demand evidence of what works, record phishing volumes remind leaders that security is still the floor.
summary: Monday's digest finds the sector moving from AI enthusiasm to accountability. 1EdTech and Learning Data Insights released a white paper on evaluating AI in education, and EdTech Digest argues vendors should keep measuring efficacy as the Education Department pushes evidence into procurement. On campus, the University of Chicago will require an AI-free first-year writing course, Eastern Illinois students are petitioning against classroom AI, and Harvard's Compass Collaborative released an age-based AI guidance matrix. Security pressure keeps climbing: Microsoft counted 7.3 billion phishing threats in Q3 and reported ransomware victims rose 23%. Ed-Fi's fall roadmap and state attendance-data stories keep interoperability in view.
footnote: Compiled from 11 curated edtech sources · NOVEMBER 16, 2026 · Direct site access was blocked in this run's network sandbox; items were gathered via web search, and some sources (ISTE, Brookings, EdTech Week, Education Technology Insights) had no new dated items, so evergreen pieces are shown.

themes.title: Evidence & AI Evaluation
themes.body: 1EdTech's new white paper and an EdTech Digest column push for measurable efficacy as federal guidance ties procurement to evidence.

themes.title: AI Guidance & Governance
themes.body: Task forces, age-based matrices and survey data show institutions formalizing AI policy while training and guidance still lag use.

themes.title: Rethinking Writing & Assessment
themes.body: From Chicago's AI-free writing course to teachers retiring the take-home essay, assessment design is being rebuilt around AI.

themes.title: Cyber Threats Escalate
themes.body: Q3 brought 7.3 billion phishing threats and a 23% jump in ransomware victims, while agentic AI is now finding software vulnerabilities.

themes.title: Student Voice & Civic Purpose
themes.body: Student petitions, AI councils and civics lessons after the midterms put learner agency at the center of the AI debate.

themes.title: Data Standards & Interoperability
themes.body: Ed-Fi's fall roadmap and state attendance dashboards show shared data standards turning into earlier interventions.
